scope: FP-MAC-PPPREHI-CUT: break the FP scalar DSP MAC output -> g_iter.pp_pre_hi pre-round combinational cone reported by T-20260902-039 by adding a multiplier-product pipeline stage in scalar_unit for MUL/FMA (including half-lane pp_pre_lo/hi); keep raw-bit/FPCR/FPSR/order semantics and only add fixed pipeline latency.

implementation.summary: In release FP_ITER=1 g_iter, added IT_MUL pipeline stage and pm_pre/pm_pre_lo/pm_pre_hi registers. Stage 1 (IT_IDLE) still captures unpacked/FZ-flushed operands to ap_pre*; stage 2 (IT_ARITH) for MUL/FMA now only captures the DSP multiplier product/sign/exponent into pm_pre*; stage 3 (IT_MUL) performs FMA alignment/add or MUL final pre-round pack and writes pp_pre*; stage 4 (IT_PREP) finishes with round_pack. This splits the T-039 mult_1~mac_11~reg0 -> pp_pre_hi.sig path (62 levels / 27.811 ns / -7.685 ns). ADD/SUB/SCVTF/UCVTF remain on the original IT_ARITH -> IT_PREP path.

semantics.raw_bit: unchanged; same unpack/FZ/round/pack helpers and finish_pre path
semantics.commit_order: unchanged; single outstanding fp_exec transaction and one held response
semantics.fpsr_fpcr: unchanged; FPCR snapshot at acceptance, FPSR OR behavior preserved
semantics.fcmp_nzcv: unchanged; CMP uses existing pp_other two-stage finish
semantics.kill_reset: pm_pre* registers cleared on reset/kill with other pipeline registers

runs.notes: Verilator lint-only on lcvex_core with release filelist

runs.command: conda run -n lcvex verilator --binary --timing --assert -j 1 --top-module lcvex_fp_exec_tb rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_fp_scalar.sv rtl/lcvex_neon_fp.sv tb/sv/lcvex_fp_exec_tb.sv && ./obj_dir_fp_exec_t040/Vlcvex_fp_exec_tb
runs.notes: Added FMUL.S=6, FMADD.S=6, NEON FMUL.2S=11 latency assertions; includes single issue, held response, kill/reset, FDIV/FSQRT latency probes

not_run: Quartus full-FP synthesis/fitter/signoff STA (next FP-P5 rerun required)
A76 required L2 lockstep sub-suite (not affected by this FP unit cut)
known_limits: No physical timing run in this task; actual Fmax/slack must be confirmed by FP-P5 rerun.
MUL/FMA and corresponding NEON/half-lane slots gained one pipeline cycle.
If STA still shows pm_pre -> pp_pre (FMA align/add) as the new top, a further product_ext/c_ext or adder split may be needed.
ADD/SUB/SCVTF/UCVTF were not further split in this round to limit area/latency impact.
